meta.title: Cryo-EM structure of the human spliceosome just prior to exon ligation at 3.6 angstrom (C* complex)
meta.organism: Homo sapiens (snRNAs and proteins); pre-mRNA substrate derived from the Human adenovirus 2 major late leader
meta.organism_note: HUMAN spliceosome - no yeast substitution was needed for this asset.
meta.state: C* complex: catalytic step-II-activated spliceosome, after branching (5' exon cleaved, intron lariat formed) and before exon ligation
meta.citation: Zhang X, Yan C, Hang J, Finci LI, Lei J, Shi Y. An Atomic Structure of the Human Spliceosome. Cell 169:918-929 (2017).

citation_fields.title: An Atomic Structure of the Human Spliceosome.

meta.units: all coordinates in Angstroms; all 'dimensions_nm' values in nanometres
meta.origin: centroid of all modelled backbone trace atoms (protein CA, nucleic P)
meta.orientation: +x = 1st principal component of the pre-mRNA phosphate path (signed 5'->3'); +z = component of (branch-point adenosine - origin) orthogonal to +x; +y = z x x. p_out = R @ (p_cif - origin).

parts_mapping.rule: explicit auth_asym_id -> part assignment; the pre-mRNA chain G is split by author residue number (negative = 5' exon, positive = intron)

entity_descriptions: Homo sapiens small nuclear RNA (U2) gene

exon.note: negative author numbering = 5' exon; in the C* state it is already cleaved from the intron at the 5' splice site

intron.note: author numbering +1 at the 5' splice site; branched (lariat) through a 2'-5' bond to the branch-point adenosine

entity_descriptions: 116 kDa U5 small nuclear ribonucleoprotein component
U5 small nuclear ribonucleoprotein 200 kDa helicase
U5 small nuclear ribonucleoprotein 40 kDa protein
Small nuclear ribonucleoprotein-associated proteins B and B

dimensions_nm.frame: oriented frame described in meta.orientation; nm
dimensions_nm.spliceosome_definition: all modelled chains of the C* complex in this entry (including the exon junction complex and AQR)
dimensions_nm.spliceosome_max_diameter_note: largest distance between any two backbone trace atoms (protein CA, RNA P); all-atom extent is ~0.5 nm larger

state_detail.name: C* complex
state_detail.note: U1 and U4 snRNA have left the spliceosome by this stage, so they are absent by biology, not by disorder. The 3' exon of the 275-nt pre-mRNA entity is not modelled (the highest modelled pre-mRNA residue is +150, still intron).

caveats: Coordinates are decimated backbone traces, not full atomic detail.
Protein traces use every 3rd CA to keep the file small; do not measure distances along protein traces.
The pre-mRNA substrate is an adenovirus-derived model substrate used in vitro, not a human transcript.
Only 84 of the 275 pre-mRNA nucleotides are modelled (18 exon + 66 intron).
This is one state of a cycle. Do not animate it as if the whole splicing reaction were captured in this one structure.

geometry.traces_note: one entry per continuous modelled stretch; xyz is a flat [x0,y0,z0,x1,...] polyline in Angstroms, 0.1 A precision

surface_spheres.note: one sphere per up to 10 consecutive residues of every modelled chain; centre = mean of the window's non-H atoms, radius = RMS atom spread + 3.0 A padding. Draw as an InstancedMesh.

splice_sites.res_numbering: author numbering of this entry's pre-mRNA construct: negative = 5' exon, +1 = first intron nucleotide

five_prime_splice_site.note: the canonical GU dinucleotide at the 5' splice site

branch_point.derivation: the only nucleotide whose O2' lies within covalent bonding distance of the 5'-terminal phosphorus of intron residue +1 in PDB 5XJC, i.e. the 2'-5' branch of the lariat; measured from the deposited coordinates

splice_sites.direction_note: In this frame the pre-mRNA runs 5'->3' towards +x and the branch point lies towards +z. The 5' exon 3'-end and the intron 5'-end are no longer joined: branching has happened.

meta.title: Minimal U1 snRNP (human U1 snRNP bound to a 5' splice site RNA)
meta.resolution_method: X-ray, highest-resolution shell reported by depositors
meta.organism_note: Engineered minimal U1 snRNP: the U1 snRNA four-helix junction is replaced by a kissing loop and stem-loop 4 is shortened. The bound 10-mer 5'-AGGUAAGUCC-3' is a 5' splice site.
meta.state: U1 snRNP with a 5' splice site RNA base-paired to the 5' end of U1 snRNA (the earliest step of splice-site recognition)
meta.citation: Kondo Y, Oubridge C, van Roon AM, Nagai K. Crystal structure of human U1 snRNP, a small nuclear ribonucleoprotein particle, reveals the mechanism of 5' splice site recognition. eLife 4:e04986 (2015).

citation_fields.title: Crystal structure of human U1 snRNP, a small nuclear ribonucleoprotein particle, reveals the mechanism of 5' splice site recognition.

meta.units: all coordinates in Angstroms; all 'dimensions_nm' values in nanometres
meta.origin: centroid of the backbone trace atoms of the selected copy
meta.orientation: +x = 5'->3' direction of the bound 5' splice site RNA (chain X); +z = component of (particle centroid - 5'SS 5' end) orthogonal to +x; +y = z x x. p_out = R @ (p_cif - origin).

parts_mapping.rule: 4PJO contains four copies of the particle in the asymmetric unit; for each polymer entity the single chain closest to 5'SS RNA chain X was kept (cutoff 45 A), so exactly one copy is exported

entity_descriptions: Small nuclear ribonucleoprotein-associated proteins B and B
U1 RNA variant (48-MER) with 4-helix junction replaced by kissing loop (HIV-1 (Mal) DIS) and shorter stem-loop 4.

five_prime_splice_site_RNA.note: 10-mer 5' splice site RNA base-paired to the 5' end of U1 snRNA

dimensions_nm.frame: oriented frame described in meta.orientation; nm
dimensions_nm.u1_definition: one copy of the minimal U1 snRNP plus the bound 5'SS RNA

caveats: ENGINEERED CONSTRUCT: the U1 snRNA four-helix junction is replaced by a kissing loop and stem-loop 4 is shortened, so this is smaller than a native U1 snRNP. Do not quote its size as the size of U1 snRNP.
U1-A and the SL2 region are not part of this minimal particle.
X-ray structure, so this is a crystal copy, not a particle in solution.
Shown as the step BEFORE the C* complex in spliceosome.json; the two structures are in different coordinate frames and must not be superposed.
meta.role: 5' splice site recognition by base pairing with the 5' end of U1 snRNA
